To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
outgroup helping as a tool to communicate ingroup warmth is motivated by the need to protect the ingroup’s positive image in the eyes of the outgroup.
ingroup members help outgroups to improve the group image of the ingroup.

ingroup members who believe that the ingroup is perceived as cold by outgroup members are more likely to help the outgroup when they are motivated to communicate a warm image of their ingrup to the outgroup.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the activation of a negative metastereotype affects outgroup helping and how this effect is moderated by group impression management motives.
the communicative nature and strategic nature of outgroup helping.
the communicative nature and function of helping behavior.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the activation of a metastereotype (i.e., a negative outgroup view of the ingroups) leads to outgroup helping as an impression management tool to communicate ingroup warmth.
direct outgroup helping is an effective tool to communicate ingroup warmth to a negative-metastereotype holder.
outgroup helping is a tool for communicating ingroup warmth when the outgroup holds a negative view of one’s ingroup.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the results suggest that direct helping is a means of communicating ingroup warmth to outgroups.
outgroup helping is a tool to communicate ingroup warmth, but only in the context of a negative metastereotype.

the results of our experiments suggest that ingroup members who are concerned about the group’s image are willing to help the outgroup as a way to communicate to them that their group is not as bad as they believe.
The main takeaway from our work is that

outgroup helping is not only a way of showing ingroup members that one is a good person but also a way of showing the outgroup that the ingroup is a good group, and it is a way of showing both that one is a member of a good group.
outgroup helping can serve as a communicative tool to signal ingroup warmth.
direct outgroup helping may be a means to signal ingroup warmth to outgroup members who are believed to hold a (negative) metastereotype.
